title: Displayed power weights stats unevenly
body: Attackers (magic, ranged, burst) carry high power; healers, tanks and supports low, so lineup swaps move team power without new resources.

title: Gear power is dynamic
body: A stat below the lineup's target counts heavily, then stops once met (an item fell 69.6M → 65M). Accuracy past ~1,000 adds little; crit resistance pads most.

title: How power is computed (claimed, decompiled)
body: A cookie's power ≈ √(offense × survival) × role weight; team power sums the cookies. So ATK alone moves power by its square root.

title: Flat versus percentage stats
body: Late, one gear line beats hundreds of Resolve levels: a +87 ATK bow line gave Milk +6k ATK, +200 Resolve ~1k. Resolve is flat; gear gets % bonuses.

title: How Stellar Link scales
body: The bonus follows the polygon area through a constellation's points, in order. Points open with total cookie stars; later constellations amplify more at the same area.

title: Stellar roll cost
body: A roll costs 10 Stellar Points unlocked, 220 with 6 points locked, the most you can lock.

title: Plating results and the 1.4.002 change
body: Since 2026-09-23: cap 25, a shatter drops 2 levels instead of to 10, and Syrup restores it (20 at 15 to 80 at 24).

title: Plating outcomes and Syrup
body: Each try: great success (+2), success (+1), maintain, decline (from 10) or shatter (from 15). Syrup blocks declines (1–3 a try) and halves shatters (2).

title: Oven level sets gear level
body: Gear level runs from oven × 3 − 5 to oven × 3; rarer gear enters the draw as oven level rises (Eternal from 31, 0.002% a draw).

title: Level can beat rarity
body: A lower-rarity piece of higher level can show more power.

title: Level 120 from 2026-10-08
body: Cap 100 → 120: +64% base stats at 120 for ~252M EXP per cookie; each level past 100 needs 5 more Crumble levels (200 for 120).

title: Chests and dungeons scale with progress
body: Coin and EXP auto-hunt chests pay by the current stage, so they are worth more opened later.

title: Extra dungeon entries compound
body: Daily dungeon keys pay by floor (64 a key low, 4,000–6,000 high), so extra entries (Crumble Pass, the 5.5 membership, key packs) compound.

title: Sweet Blessing is a spending track
body: Perks, not stats: daily dungeon entries, a Wind Archer copy at level 3. About 10% of spend fills it; level 3 under ~100,000 KRW; 12 levels.

title: Conquest damage per stat line (claimed)
body: A guild's leaked sheet: +1% skill amp ≈ +2% damage, +15% crit dmg ≈ +4%, +15% crit rate ≈ +3%, +650 ATK ≈ +2.5%. Rolls differ: crit rate to ~23%, crit dmg ~16%.

title: Gear sub-stat pools by slot group
body: Skill amp rolls on weapons and upper accessories only; haste on accessories only; damage reduction and crit resistance on armour and lower accessories.

title: Crit resistance pads power only
body: The Conquest boss never crits, so crit resistance does nothing there yet adds displayed power: one helmet lost 108M swapping it for HP.

title: Fame is damage
body: Each Fame level adds 2% boss, elemental or crit damage in turn (Lv.30: +20% each), so it counts in Conquest though not in Arena.

title: Mercenary perks are one setting for every mode
body: Passion Pay gives the ATK #1 ally +20% ATK (Milk in Conquest); players swap perks by hand before Conquest. Band Lv.4 opens a second slot.
